history.content: Hi, my phone has no signal at all. Nothing loads, I can't send picture messages, and I can't get online or make a call. Can you help?

I can help you troubleshoot this issue. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I can begin diagnosing the problem.
My phone number is +1-617-555-0148. My name is Sofia Martinez.

Thank you for the information. Your line status is currently active, so let's begin troubleshooting your no signal issue.

To proceed, could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:
- Airplane mode icon
- “No SIM” or “SIM error” message
- Signal bars (even if empty or with an “x”)
- Any other unusual icons

This will help me determine the next steps. If you’re unsure how to check, let me know and I can guide you.
My status bar shows the Airplane Mode icon, 'No Signal', and Data Enabled. The battery is at 87%.

It looks like Airplane Mode is enabled on your phone. When Airplane Mode is on, all wireless connections—including cellular service—are turned off, which explains why you have no signal and can’t make calls, use data, or send picture messages.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. Once you do, check if your signal returns and let me know what you see in your status bar. If you need instructions on how to turn off Airplane Mode, just let me know your phone type (Android or iPhone) and I can guide you through the steps.
Airplane mode is now off, but my phone still isn’t showing any signal bars—just an empty signal icon. I still can’t get online or make calls.

Thank you for turning off Airplane Mode. Since you still have no signal, the next step is to check your SIM card status, as issues with the SIM can also cause a complete loss of service.

Please check your SIM card status on your phone. If you need help with this, let me know your phone type (Android or iPhone), and I can guide you through the steps. Once you have the SIM status (e.g., Active, Missing, Locked), please let me know what it says.
I just checked, and my SIM card status actually says 'Locked.' What should I do next?
YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.

arguments.summary: Customer's SIM card is locked, resulting in no signal and inability to use phone services. Needs assistance unlocking the SIM.
